claims.claim: ispace-EUROPE and ALTEC signed a memorandum of understanding at the 77th International Astronautical Congress in Antalya, Türkiye.
claims.supporting_quote: Vincenzo Giorgio, CEO of ALTEC, and Julien-Alexandre Lamamy, CEO of ispace-EUROPE, following the ceremonial signing of the MoU at the 77 th International Astronautical Congress (IAC) in Antalya, Türkiye.

claims.claim: ALTEC operates the Rover Operations Control Centre for ESA’s ExoMars Rosalind Franklin rover.
claims.supporting_quote: Since 2019, ALTEC has operated the Rover Operations Control Centre (ROCC), the mission control facility for ESA’s ExoMars Rosalind Franklin rover, which is currently used for ground testing of rover systems.

claims.claim: ALTEC is developing a new Lunar Simulation Centre funded by the Italian Space Agency.
claims.supporting_quote: ALTEC is also developing a new Lunar Simulation Centre, funded by the Italian Space Agency (ASI), dedicated to the simulation and testing of robotic lunar exploration missions and related operational activities.
